metadata.description: Automated QA1 and bi-weekly regression testing for Medtrics with Chrome MCP execution, visual evidence capture, and Optimus/GitLab integration.

plugins.name: medtrics-qa-automation
plugins.description: Automated QA1 for Medtrics. Reads a human-authored QA Checklist from the Optimus ticket or its GitLab MR, walks each step via Chrome MCP, judges every step by code, captures per-step screenshots + console + network as visual evidence, and posts verdict threads with a plain-English summary plus inline screenshots so QA2 reviewers can audit a run without re-driving the browser. Moves the Optimus ticket per the verdict policy. Phase-gated; shadow by default.
